008package paint.compare;
009
010import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
011import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.Set;
015import java.util.function.Function;
016
017/**
018 * Compares two tables represented as lists of {@code column -> value} row maps.
019 *
020 * <p>Rows are matched <b>by key, 1:1</b> (not positionally), so a difference in
021 * row ordering between the two files is never reported as a difference — the
022 * caller supplies a key function that uniquely identifies a row (e.g. the
023 * {@code Unique Key} column for tracks, or {@code Recording + Square} for
024 * squares). For each matched pair, every non-ignored field is compared: numeric
025 * fields within a tolerance, everything else as trimmed strings. Rows present on
026 * only one side are reported as missing/extra; a repeated key is reported as a
027 * duplicate (the key is then not unique and its comparison is unreliable).</p>
028 *
029 * <p>Loading CSVs is deliberately <b>not</b> this class's concern — it operates
030 * on already-parsed rows, so the comparison logic is pure and unit-testable.</p>
031 */
032public final class TableComparer {
033
034    private TableComparer() {
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * @param baseline        rows of the reference/old file
039     * @param test            rows of the new file
040     * @param keyFn           extracts a unique row key
041     * @param ignoreColumns   column names to skip entirely
042     * @param numericTolerance max absolute difference tolerated between two numeric values
043     * @return a structured {@link ComparisonResult}
044     */
045    public static ComparisonResult compare(
046            List<Map<String, String>> baseline,
047            List<Map<String, String>> test,
048            Function<Map<String, String>, String> keyFn,
049            Set<String> ignoreColumns,
050            double numericTolerance) {
051
052        ComparisonResult result = new ComparisonResult();
053
054        Map<String, Map<String, String>> baseByKey = index(baseline, keyFn, result);
055        Map<String, Map<String, String>> testByKey = index(test, keyFn, result);
056
057        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, String>> entry : baseByKey.entrySet()) {
058            String              key = entry.getKey();
059            Map<String, String> b   = entry.getValue();
060            Map<String, String> t   = testByKey.get(key);
061
062            if (t == null) {
063                result.addMissing(key);
064                continue;
065            }
066
067            result.incComparedRows();
068
069            Set<String> fields = new LinkedHashSet<>();
070            fields.addAll(b.keySet());
071            fields.addAll(t.keySet());
072
073            boolean anyDifference = false;
074            for (String field : fields) {
075                if (ignoreColumns.contains(field)) {
076                    continue;
077                }
078                String bv = trim(b.get(field));
079                String tv = trim(t.get(field));
080                if (!equalWithinTolerance(bv, tv, numericTolerance)) {
081                    result.addValueDifference(key, field, bv, tv);
082                    anyDifference = true;
083                }
084            }
085            if (!anyDifference) {
086                result.incIdenticalRows();
087            }
088        }
089
090        for (String key : testByKey.keySet()) {
091            if (!baseByKey.containsKey(key)) {
092                result.addExtra(key);
093            }
094        }
095
096        return result;
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Compares two tables using a pluggable {@link FieldComparator}, which decides
101     * per column whether to skip it and whether two values count as a difference.
102     * Row matching (by key, 1:1), missing/extra/duplicate handling, and result
103     * accounting are identical to the tolerance-based overload above.
104     *
105     * @param baseline   rows of the reference/old file
106     * @param test       rows of the new file
107     * @param keyFn      extracts a unique row key
108     * @param comparator the per-field comparison policy
109     * @return a structured {@link ComparisonResult}
110     */
111    public static ComparisonResult compare(
112            List<Map<String, String>> baseline,
113            List<Map<String, String>> test,
114            Function<Map<String, String>, String> keyFn,
115            FieldComparator comparator) {
116
117        ComparisonResult result = new ComparisonResult();
118
119        Map<String, Map<String, String>> baseByKey = index(baseline, keyFn, result);
120        Map<String, Map<String, String>> testByKey = index(test, keyFn, result);
121
122        for (Map.Entry<String, Map<String, String>> entry : baseByKey.entrySet()) {
123            String              key = entry.getKey();
124            Map<String, String> b   = entry.getValue();
125            Map<String, String> t   = testByKey.get(key);
126
127            if (t == null) {
128                result.addMissing(key);
129                continue;
130            }
131
132            result.incComparedRows();
133
134            Set<String> fields = new LinkedHashSet<>();
135            fields.addAll(b.keySet());
136            fields.addAll(t.keySet());
137
138            boolean anyDifference = false;
139            for (String field : fields) {
140                if (comparator.isIgnored(field)) {
141                    continue;
142                }
143                String bv = trim(b.get(field));
144                String tv = trim(t.get(field));
145                if (!comparator.equal(field, bv, tv, b, t)) {
146                    result.addValueDifference(key, field, bv, tv);
147                    anyDifference = true;
148                }
149            }
150            if (!anyDifference) {
151                result.incIdenticalRows();
152            }
153        }
154
155        for (String key : testByKey.keySet()) {
156            if (!baseByKey.containsKey(key)) {
157                result.addExtra(key);
158            }
159        }
160
161        return result;
162    }
163
164    /** Index rows by key; a repeated key is recorded as a duplicate (last wins in the map). */
165    private static Map<String, Map<String, String>> index(
166            List<Map<String, String>> rows,
167            Function<Map<String, String>, String> keyFn,
168            ComparisonResult result) {
169
170        Map<String, Map<String, String>> byKey = new LinkedHashMap<>();
171        for (Map<String, String> row : rows) {
172            String key = keyFn.apply(row);
173            if (byKey.put(key, row) != null) {
174                result.addDuplicateKey(key);
175            }
176        }
177        return byKey;
178    }
179
180    private static String trim(String s) {
181        return s == null ? "" : s.trim();
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * Two values are equal if their trimmed strings match, or if both parse as
186     * numbers within {@code tol} (with NaN treated as equal to NaN).
187     */
188    static boolean equalWithinTolerance(String a, String b, double tol) {
189        if (a.equals(b)) {
190            return true;
191        }
192        Double da = parseDouble(a);
193        Double db = parseDouble(b);
194        if (da != null && db != null) {
195            if (Double.isNaN(da) && Double.isNaN(db)) {
196                return true;
197            }
198            return Math.abs(da - db) <= tol;
199        }
200        return false;
201    }
202
203    private static Double parseDouble(String s) {
204        if (s == null || s.isEmpty()) {
205            return null;
206        }
207        try {
208            return Double.parseDouble(s);
209        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
210            return null;
211        }
212    }
213}
